fixed_research_goal: DRL trained on large complex10x10 parent scenes, frozen policy for variable4x3/6x6/8x8 local tasks, complete constraint-validated execution paths; supervision only auxiliary init/control
current_scope: S0 environment consistency, untrained policies, finite gradient probes, freeze future protocol; NO S1/S2 optimization or S3 performance execution

semantics.window: table-index task subset, NOT physically cropped navigation map; all original obstacles and corridors retained; paths may leave task window
semantics.candidates: all same-arm(F&A) positive-coverage candidates with entry and exit connectivity, including candidates outside selected tables
semantics.state: global context, local effective F/C, remaining tasks, current node, explicit exit and complete ordered prefix
semantics.action: one positive-gain legal service pose; no early STOP; at most task_count actions
semantics.endpoints: local symbol0 outgoing uses entry→candidate, incoming uses candidate→exit; service-service distances symmetric. Empty task uses direct entry→exit cost.
semantics.reward: step -Dmove-.75; last adds -Dexit + Jraw-JH; sum reward=-JH. Empty task terminal reward=-Dentry,exit.
semantics.H: original byte-identical normalize/two_opt60 twice + joint_search2 + normalize, applied to explicit endpoint cost adapter; open path uses new independent validator
semantics.physical: proxy or externally supplied F/A table consistency; no invented IK/collision/joint-trajectory evidence

cases.center_endpoints: first and last depot-connected original candidate nodes
cases.A_conditions: all allowed; deterministic same-arm restrictions retaining one valid pair per task; synthetic allow table only

policies: untrained global/local/prefix stochastic policy greedy endpoint

neural.global_tokens: 100 table14-feature tokens: geometry/task density/obstacle count/true neighboring navigation
neural.local: task5/candidate7 effective bipartite encoder; true current/exit navigation; full-prefix incremental GRU
neural.global_context_identity: scene+task+F+A hash; never cache by static map alone
neural.gradient_probe: three legal forced first stops per8x8 center view, same instance mean return baseline; forced step contributes no policy logprob; one accumulated backward, zero optimizer steps

limits.termination: cooperative checks between work and before successful completion; overrun/error => incomplete, preserve attempts; no silent replacement seed

gate: All view slices equal independent parent calculations, preserve parent inputs, all produced plans validate, rewards telescope, exact action replay, masked policy distribution and finite structural/empirical gradients, unchanged neural parameters, no optimizer/heldout60 calls
future_training: separately registered S2_S3_protocol.json held NOT_STARTED; source binding for future trainer/baseline conformance mandatory before any formal optimizer
